claims.text: A newly developed interatomic potential can determine melting temperature across the high-entropy-alloy family accurately.
The potential can determine enthalpy and entropy of fusion across the high-entropy-alloy family accurately.
The potential can determine volume change at melting across the high-entropy-alloy family accurately.
The potential can determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties across the high-entropy-alloy family accurately.
Use of the proposed potential would determine these thermodynamic properties efficiently relative to prior measurement and modeling methods.
The proposed approach is applicable across the high-entropy-alloy family, including solid and liquid phases.
The new interatomic potential can be developed using DFT or molecular-dynamics simulations.
The approach can be validated by comparing predicted melting and liquid thermodynamic properties with experimental data for a subset of high-entropy alloys.
Significant deviation of predicted values from experimental data would rule out the proposed approach.
